import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem finite_invariant_intersection_common_submodule {F V ι : Type*} [NormedField F] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace F V] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (u : ι → Submodule F V) (f g : V →L[F] V) (hf : ∀ i : ι, ∀ x : V, x ∈ u i → f x ∈ u i) (hg : ∀ i : ι, ∀ x : V, x ∈ u i → g x ∈ u i) (hfg : ∀ x : V, f (g x) = g (f x)) : ∃ U : Submodule F V, (⋂ i : ι, (u i : Set V)) = (U : Set V) ∧ (∀ x : V, x ∈ U → f x ∈ U) ∧ (∀ x : V, x ∈ U → g x ∈ U) ∧ (∀ x : U, f (g (x : V)) = g (f (x : V))) ∧ (∀ W : Submodule F V, W ≤ U ↔ ∀ i : ι, W ≤ u i) := by
  use ⨅ i, u i
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext x
    simp [Submodule.mem_iInf]
  · intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    intro i
    exact hf i x (hx i)
  · intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    intro i
    exact hg i x (hx i)
  · intro x
    exact hfg (x : V)
  · intro W
    exact le_iInf_iff
